summary: Onex Direct Lending BDC Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 (Regulation FD) and 8.01 to disclose third-quarter 2026 portfolio commentary. As of September 30, 2026, NAV per share was $17.04 versus $17.31 at June 30; net investment income was $0.44 per share against $0.53 of dividends, an annualized 12.44% distribution yield. Portfolio fair value was $261.6 million across 43 companies, 97% first lien, 99% floating rate, with 0.94x net leverage, 200% asset coverage, and one non-accrual position at 0.2%. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics disclosed; watch portfolio credit migration and NAV erosion.
